2. **Deployment** — Rolled out hotfix `v2.3.2` to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Status: `rolled_out`.

Recommendation: monitor the error rate closely; if v2.3.2 doesn't resolve the issue, the last known healthy version is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1 and its RC were also unhealthy), and a rollback would be the next step.
